FactionDef.label: hostile famine ratkin
FactionDef.description: Ratkin driven out of a ruined settlement. They have no tools and little food left, and they take what they can reach.\n\nThey are hostile to the colony. Hurting them does not start a raid.

FactionDef.label: wary famine ratkin
FactionDef.description: Ratkin driven out of a ruined settlement. They watch the colony and keep their distance.\n\nThey are not hostile yet. If a colonist hurts one of them, that whole group turns hostile. They still do not raid.

FactionDef.label: famine ratkin
FactionDef.description: Ratkin driven out of a ruined settlement. They beg, steal, or pass through, depending on the group.\n\nThey stay neutral if a colonist hurts one of them. Forcing the group out makes them hostile. They do not raid.

FactionDef.label: approachable famine ratkin
FactionDef.description: Ratkin driven out of a ruined settlement. They will come to the gate for food.\n\nIf a colonist hurts one of them, that whole group leaves. They do not turn hostile, and they do not raid.

FactionDef.label: friendly famine ratkin
FactionDef.description: Ratkin driven out of a ruined settlement. They will take food only from a relief area, if one is marked.\n\nIf a colonist hurts one of them, that whole group leaves. They stay friendly, and they do not raid.
